title: 模块 Offload 预取配置

standard.summary: 模块 offload 的预取和性能分析控制：prefetch_enabled 启用异步预取（在当前 block 计算时预取下一个 block）；profile 模式记录每个模块的传输时间；ratio 控制整体 offload 比例。
standard.effect: prefetch 让 GPU 计算与 CPU-GPU 数据传输重叠，提升 offload 效率（减少等待时间）；profile 帮助识别传输瓶颈。
standard.whenToUse: 使用 module_offload 时推荐同时开启 prefetch；profile 在性能调优时使用。verify_state 在每次换入/换出时验证数据完整性（调试用）。
standard.avoidWhen: verify_state 有显著额外开销，只在怀疑数据损坏时临时开启。

standard_en.summary: Prefetch and profiling controls for module offload: prefetch_enabled turns on asynchronous prefetch (fetching the next block while the current one computes); profile mode records each module's transfer time; ratio controls the overall offload proportion.
standard_en.effect: Prefetch overlaps GPU compute with CPU-GPU transfer, making offload more efficient (less waiting); profile helps identify the transfer bottleneck.
standard_en.whenToUse: Enabling prefetch alongside module_offload is recommended; profile is for performance tuning. verify_state checks data integrity on every swap in and out (for debugging).
standard_en.avoidWhen: verify_state has significant extra overhead, so only turn it on temporarily when you suspect data corruption.
